decisions_made.decision: Test-suite strength is enforced by MUTATION TESTING: a package ships only at 100% killed (non-equivalent) mutants, decided by tooling not trust
decisions_made.rationale: A bugged Goldman solution once passed 17/18 tests; verify_all/audit can't see a weak suite. Mutation testing measures it directly

decisions_made.decision: Grok (cursor-grok-4.5-high) MAY bulk-author OA-judge questions, gated by gate_candidate.py in a clean isolated staging clone; nothing merges without GATE: PASS
decisions_made.rationale: Author identity is irrelevant to the gate; safe because quality is tooling-enforced (anchor + brute + audit + 100% mutation). DSA-notes prose is still Claude-only

decisions_made.decision: A mutant that TIMES OUT or CRASHES on a reference-tractable input is KILLED, not skipped; oracle is computed reliably (retry then drop uncomputable inputs); per-mutant timeout is adaptive
decisions_made.rationale: Skipping timeouts made an infinite-loop mutant survive then re-run 80x -> 30min hang; treating a load blip as data made the score flap 100<->96.8

decisions_made.decision: The +-1 fuzzer only perturbs PAYLOAD rows (>=3 numeric tokens), never header/count lines; and run() flags a non-zero exit as unreliable
decisions_made.rationale: Perturbing a count field (r>M, N) desyncs the grammar / crashes the reference, so a harmless mutant 'differs' -> a bogus edge test (phantom gap)

decisions_made.decision: A Python-only reference is a hard gate FAIL (mutation_test mutates C++ only) until a C++ ref or Python-mutation support exists
decisions_made.rationale: A skipped mutation step must not read as PASS -- that is the exact 'bugged code slips through' failure the gate prevents

decisions_made.decision: Statements keep LaTeX; the renderer converts it (Unicode + sup/sub), no KaTeX/JS
decisions_made.rationale: Grok emits \(...\); fixing the renderer once beats sanitizing every problem forever; stays offline/dependency-free

decisions_made.decision: Topic is searchable (free-text q matches topic) but HIDDEN on the problem view
decisions_made.rationale: Seeing the topic gives away the approach; a real OA doesn't. Company still shows

decisions_made.decision: Hidden tests are stored gzipped (transparent read); deploy the .gz-reader app BEFORE any .gz bank goes live
decisions_made.rationale: Hidden max-scale inputs dominate size; 2.9x smaller ~doubles the free-3GB-volume ceiling. Ordering avoids a live app that can't read the new bank

errors_encountered.resolution: Reliable oracle (retry@4x, drop uncomputable); mutant timeout/crash = KILL with one confirm-retry; adaptive per-mutant timeout; never run two heavy mutation procs at once (that OOM-crashed the 10GB WSL VM -- the 'crash', NOT Grok)

errors_encountered.error: Phantom gaps: fuzzer mangled a count field / crashed the reference, so a harmless i<n->i<=n mutant looked killable
errors_encountered.resolution: Grammar-safe fuzzer (payload rows only) + run() treats non-zero exit as <ERR> so the oracle drops crash inputs and triage skips them

errors_encountered.error: User report: vertex-disappearance constraints showed raw \(2 \le N \le 10^5\)
errors_encountered.resolution: Renderer didn't process LaTeX; added inline-math -> Unicode/sup/sub in app/runner/md.py. Problem itself verified correct (3000-case independent simulation)

errors_encountered.error: User couldn't find the bug-report control (buried at statement bottom)
errors_encountered.resolution: Added an always-visible Report button in the problem tab bar (opens the same box)
Its reference is Python (bignum); mutation_test mutates C++ only. DEFERRED (not merged). Fix later: mod-1e9+7 C++ ref, or add Python mutation support. Staging copy kept in ../oa-staging/agentD/out/
